newsitem.title: USA: ITT Educational 1996 enrollment up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: ITT Educational 1996 enrollment up 10 pct.

text.p: ITT Educational Services Inc, a private college system offering technology-oriented programs of study, said Wednesday that total student enrollment at its ITT Technical Institutes rose 10 percent to 22,633 students at the end of 1996.
The same-college new student enrollments, or enrollments at ITT Technical Institutes open more than 24 months, in 1996 increased 13 percent over 1995 to 21,040 students.

The company also reported a five percent increase in new student enrollments for the 1996 December term, with a total of 3,330 new students enrolled compared with 3,183 students for the same term in 1995.

The number of first-time students enrolling in the 1996 December term was 2,712 students compared with 2,591 students for the same term in 1995, a five percent increase, it said. Increased enrollments reflect a higher number of high school graduates seeking postsecondary education and a growing percentage of adults returning to school for technology training, ITT Educational said in a statement.

"Given our strong enrollment growth, we are well positioned to continue our long-term record of consistent earnings growth into 1997," said Rene Champagne, chairman, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.

ITT Educational operates 59 ITT Technical Institutes in 26 states. Some 4.5 million shares, or 16.7 percent of the company's common stock, trade on the New York Stock Exchange. ITT Corp owns the remaining 83.3 percent of the common stock. ((Chicago newsdesk 312 408 8787))
